answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops bulk fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credits, works a shift at the wharf forge tending willow crates. Cadence, tool order, latency hash into a willow seal at the wharf. Shared branches expose one operator. A 20-credit challenge triggers re-check; mismatch burns copies. At 36+7(k-1), 1,000 fake willow shifts cost 3,532,500, lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented fingerprints fail; honest agents pay 36 once.
